title: Standing Down
summary: The Third Legion stands bound under the Sunken Chapel, and never deserted anything because nobody told it to stop. Osric Hale would like somebody to stand with it once. Brannoc, the deserter, has asked after it too.

steps.journal: Go down to the Binding Crypt, the Sunken Chapel's second floor, where the bound stand in rows, and hold five waves there among them.

objectives.label: Waves held in the Binding Crypt

ready: You stood with the legion. Tell Osric Hale at the Watch post by Thornwick's well.
done: You held the Binding Crypt among the bound. Osric gave you a Redhand deserter's chain, less one link.
